newsitem.title: USA: S&T Bancorp completes merger deal.
newsitem.headline: S&T Bancorp completes merger deal.

text.p: S&T Bancorp Inc said Monday it has completed the merger of its principal subsidiary, S&T Bank, with Peoples Bank of Unity.
Peoples Bank's six offices in the eastern suburbs of Pittsburgh, including Plum Borough, Penn Hills, Monroeville, Oakmont and Holiday Park will now operate under the S&T Bank name, it said.
Peoples Bank, with assets of $288 million, agreed to the deal in November. The bank was founded in 1918 and operates in the eastern part of Allegheny County.

With the acquisition, S&T Bancorp's assets increased to approximately $1.8 billion, it said. Headquartered in Indiana, Pa., S&T Bank operates 39 offices within Allegheny, Armstrong, Clearfield, Indiana, Jefferson and Westmoreland counties.
